none: PAS GLO-1B5825: Roman nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Gloucestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. Barbarous copy. Date: 335-341. Diameter 14mm, thickness 1.1mm, weight 1.02g. Obverse: pearl diademed, draped, cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: […]. Reverse: Two soldiers either side of one standard. Reverse inscription: GLORIA EXERCITVS. Die axes: 6 o’clock. Condition: fair
